title: Conscious Campaign - Book Club: Black Privilege By Charlamagne Tha God
htmlContent: This week the cast from the Conscious Campaign book club dives into their interpretation of Charlamagne Tha God new book "Black Privilege"  Some of the things that were intriguing to the group was Charlamagne Tha God growing up in a small town. Some other things that caught their attention are some of the topics on The Breakfast Club and that he does not hold his tongue for no one. Charalamagne Tha God he's known for Kanye that his 808 album was trash to his face and other celebrities outlandish comments as well.  You can check out the full podcast of the Conscious Campaign Book Club Episode 1 below!       https://soundcloud.com/consciouscampaign/book-club-black-privilege-episode-1
